extraction.Name: Carrie Clara Huggins Longcor
extraction.Cancelled: I am not and wish to have it cancelled
extraction.Refused/Protested: No i was in Todd county at the time the patent arrived at our home in Tripp count.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the taxes are an added burden
extraction.Occupation/Income: We work for our living on the farm
extraction.NOTES: Allottee did not ask for the patent and wishes to have it cancelled. States she does not remember signing a receipt for the patent. Health is variable: 'Sometimes I feel well and at others I do not.' Has three living children. Notarized May 9, 1929 before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
